specs.title: AUTH-066 short access Home mount acquires recovery

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled identity, catalog, API responses and browser time. Signed current-BFF validation is used only where declared. Synthetic credentials and user aliases; no real identity provider acceptance.

steps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context
2. And restored fixture workspace WS-A is configured; access A expires in 10 seconds; no refresh credential exists
3. When the Home page finishes its initial mount
4. Then the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
5. When the fixture accepts that acquisition with refresh R valid beyond access expiry
6. And the controlled browser clock advances exactly 10 seconds
7. Then the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
8. When User A clicks the button labelled "Extend" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired"
9. Then the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"
10. And the recovery POST header Single-UI-Refresh equals R
11. When the fixture accepts manual recovery with a new access credential
12. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible
13. And the installed access credential equals the accepted recovery response credential

specs.title: AUTH-112 fresh login acquires distinct recovery

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled identity, catalog, API responses and browser time. Signed current-BFF validation is used only where declared. Synthetic credentials and user aliases; no real identity provider acceptance.

steps.title: 1. Given User A completed logout; the previous SESSION-A and refresh R-A are recorded
2. And the LOCAL login page is visible in the same isolated browser context
3. And the credential fixture accepts user-a / FixturePass1! with new SESSION-B and workspace WS-A
4. When User A enters "user-a" into the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page
5. And User A enters "FixturePass1!" into the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page
6. And User A clicks the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page
7. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible
8. When the browser changes this page from visible to hidden
9. Then the acquisition POST body uses the new SESSION-B access credential
10. When the fixture accepts acquisition for SESSION-B
11. Then the installed refresh credential belongs to SESSION-B and differs from R-A
